targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN value LIKE 'Fall %' THEN value
    ELSE 
      CONCAT(
        SPLIT_PART(value, ' ', 1), 
        ' ', 
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(value, ' ', 2) AS INT) + 1
      )
  END AS adjusted_term
FROM metadata
WHERE key = 'current_term';
SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE key = 'last_updated';

panels.description:
Data from Drexel Term Master Schedule and Rate My Professors to allow you to make an informed decision before choosing a course.

Click on the filters above the table and the filter icon next to the column name to filter the data. Click on the column name to sort the data.

Most Drexel TMS data is updated every 20 minutes to make sure the data is up to date (particularly the seats taken). Rate My Professors data is updated every week. 

NOTE: if the scraper can't scrape certain fields, it will show up as a blank cell.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT course_id AS "CRN", subject_code AS "Subject Code", course_number AS "Course Number", course_title AS "Course Title", section AS "Section", instructor_name AS "Instructor Name", instructor_rmp_id AS "RateMyProfessors ID", avg_rating AS "Average RMP Rating", avg_difficulty AS "Average RMP Difficulty", num_ratings AS "Number of RMP Ratings", enroll AS "Seats Taken", max_enroll AS "Total Seats", instruction_type AS "Instruction Type", instruction_method AS "Instruction Method", credits AS "Credits", prereqs AS "Prerequisites", to_char(start_time, 'HH12:MI AM') AS "Start Time", to_char(end_time, 'HH12:MI AM') AS "End Time", array_to_string(days, ', ') AS "Days"
FROM all_course_instructor_data
WHERE 
    (
        ('$null_ratings' = 'Yes')
        OR 
        ('$null_ratings' = 'No' AND avg_rating IS NOT NULL)
    )
    AND 
    (
        avg_difficulty IS NULL 
        OR avg_difficulty <= $max_difficulty
    )
    AND 
    (
        avg_rating IS NULL 
        OR avg_rating >= $min_rating
    )
    AND 
    (
        num_ratings IS NULL 
        OR num_ratings >= $min_num_ratings
    )
    AND
    (
        CASE 
            WHEN course_number ~ E'\\d+' THEN 
                CAST(substring(course_number FROM E'\\d+') AS INTEGER) > $course_number_greater_than 
                AND CAST(substring(course_number FROM E'\\d+') AS INTEGER) < $course_number_less_than
            ELSE TRUE
        END
    )
    AND 
    (
        ('$allow_null_times' = 'Yes')
        OR
        ('$allow_null_times' = 'No' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND end_time IS NOT NULL)
    )
    AND 
    (
        start_time IS NULL 
        OR start_time >= CAST('$start_time' AS time)
    )
    AND 
    (
        end_time IS NULL 
        OR end_time <= CAST('$end_time' AS time)
    )
    AND 
    (
        ('$show_full_courses' = 'Yes')
        OR
        ('$show_full_courses' = 'No' AND enroll <> 'FULL')
    )
    AND
    (
        ('$only_blank_prereqs' = 'Yes')
        OR
        ('$only_blank_prereqs' = 'No' AND prereqs = '')
    )
ORDER BY 
    subject_code ASC, 
    CAST(substring(course_number FROM '[0-9]+') AS INTEGER) ASC;

panels.title: All Courses

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*)
FROM 
    instructors
WHERE 
    num_ratings > 0 AND num_ratings IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    AVG(num_ratings) AS total_instructor_ratings
FROM 
    instructors

SELECT 
    AVG(avg_rating) AS total_instructor_ratings
FROM 
    instructors

SELECT 
    AVG(avg_difficulty) AS total_instructor_ratings
FROM 
    instructors

SELECT 
    instruction_method,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
    courses
GROUP BY 
    instruction_method
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

SELECT 
    credits,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
    courses
GROUP BY 
    credits
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN start_time >= '05:00:00' AND start_time < '12:00:00' THEN 'Morning'
        WHEN start_time >= '12:00:00' AND start_time < '17:00:00' THEN 'Afternoon'
        WHEN start_time >= '17:00:00' AND start_time <= '23:59:59' THEN 'Evening'
        ELSE 'Undefined'
    END AS time_of_day,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
    courses
WHERE
    start_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    time_of_day;

panels.title: Class Distribution by Time of Day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    unnested_days,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
    (
        SELECT UNNEST(days) AS unnested_days
        FROM courses
        WHERE days IS NOT NULL
    ) AS unnested
GROUP BY 
    unnested_days
ORDER BY 
    count DESC;

panels.title: Class Distribution by Day of Week

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    CONCAT(subject_code, ' ', course_number) AS "Course",
    COUNT(*) AS "Sections"
FROM 
    courses
GROUP BY 
    subject_code, course_number
ORDER BY 
    "Sections" DESC
LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Top 10 Courses with the Most Number of Sections

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    course_id AS "CRN",
    CONCAT(subject_code, ' ', course_number) AS "Course",
    instructor_name AS "Instructor",
    avg_difficulty AS "Average Difficulty"
FROM 
    all_course_instructor_data
WHERE 
    num_ratings >= 5 AND avg_difficulty IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    avg_difficulty ASC
LIMIT 10;
